title: Editor freezing after mouse hovering over sub-menu options
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and reproduced in the following versions on Linux:

- 4.6-rc2
- 4.5.1
- 4.5
- 4.4
- 4.0
- 4.0-alpha15

I couldn't test any ealier alphas as the links are 404s.

I could not reproduce in the following versions:

- 3.7-dev1
- 3.0

Additionally, I tested 4.5.1 on Mac OS and it was fine. This issue seems to be Linux-specific.


### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.51 GiB memory

### Issue description

Editor freezing and becoming totally unresponsive after opening a sub-menu (examples listed below) and hovering over a sub-menu item. Sometimes it happens very quickly, but other times you have to hover over different items for a while before the freeze happens.

- View > Gizmos
- View > Preview Translation
- Editor > Editor Docks
- Scene > Open Recent (even though it was a greyed out menu with no options, as I had no recent scenes, still caused the freeze)
- Right click in filesystem > Create New

I left one sub-menu open for 25 minutes while away from the computer without hovering over any sub-menu items, and there was no freeze, but after about 20 seconds hovering over different sub-menu items, it froze. So it seems to be related to hovering over sub-menu items, not just having them open. 

I couldn't get it to freeze on the new nodes menu or any top-level menu. It seems to be limited to sub-menus.

Seems to be fixed by enabling Editor setting "single window mode".

Possibly related to the following:

- #114280
- #112843

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce:

- Create a new project.
- Select a drop-down menu, for instance the 2D or 3D "View" menu.
- Open any sub-menu: View > Gizmos, for instance.
- Sometimes it will freeze after a few seconds, but if not move the mouse rapidly over different sub-menu options. The editor should freeze within 30 seconds.
- Use system monitor or some other means to kill the program, and the whole window system will hang for a while. Sometimes, journalctl shows a message: 

> kwin_wayland[2324]: The main thread was hanging temporarily!


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Just create a new empty project.
